standard_prerequisites.name: Push-pull adjunction for modules: Mor_{Mod(f^{-1}O_Y)}(f^{-1}G, F) = Hom_{O_Y}(G, f_*F)
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the second equality of the chain.

core_obligations: By the definition of the pullback for ringed spaces, f^*G = O_X tensor_{f^{-1}O_Y} f^{-1}G (proof lines 3391-3394). The tensor-restrict adjunction for sheaves of modules turns Hom_{O_X}(f^*G, F) into Mor_{Mod(f^{-1}O_Y)}(f^{-1}G, F_{f^{-1}O_Y}) (proof lines 3395-3398, justified at 3400-3401). The push-pull adjunction for modules then identifies this with Hom_{O_Y}(G, f_*F) (proof lines 3398-3400, justified at 3401-3402). Both equalities are bifunctorial, giving the asserted adjunction f^* left adjoint to f_* (proof lines 3389-3404).
proof_roadmap: Unfold f^*G as the tensor and apply the tensor-restrict adjunction (proof lines 3391-3401).
Apply the push-pull adjunction to land in Hom_{O_Y}(G, f_*F) (proof lines 3401-3402).
